title: Situation recap
headline: CPN's reach of 44 shopping centres at end-2025 and about 510 million visits a year is strong, but three issues need attention.

S: About 510 million visits a year; The 1 loyalty data
W: Costly to keep a premium experience (team assessment)
O: Tourists beyond China: South Asia and long-haul
Net Zero 2050 as a point of difference
T: Rivals: Siam Piwat, The Mall Group
Household debt 85.9% of GDP (Q1 2026); credit is tight

issues.title: E-commerce takes retail share
issues.why: Online share of Thai retail sales: 20.45% to 23.50%, 2022 to 2024

issues.title: Tourism depends on China
issues.why: Chinese arrivals fell 33.55% y/y in 2025, rose 16.05% in Jan–Aug 2026

issues.title: Capital-heavy mega-projects
issues.why: The Central Phaholyothin alone is a ฿21 billion investment

notes: CPN's reach is strong: it ended 2025 with 44 shopping centres and 16 community malls across 23 provinces. Weaknesses, in our assessment: reliance on physical retail and the cost of a premium experience. Three issues need attention: e-commerce, tourism that leans on China, and heavy investment in mega-projects. Chinese arrivals fell 33.55 percent year on year in 2025 and rose 16.05 percent in January to August 2026.
